title: Unchecked -ENOBUFS at neighbors_get/routes_get fallback call sites
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_status.c:706-710,881-885. Error-contract change makes encoders able to return negative where 0 previously possible; two fallback sites pass len unchecked into respond() -> (size_t)(-ENOBUFS) huge length class sending uninitialized memory on any future size regression (same class as closed dadw). Add len<0 branches mirroring :727-730/:903-906 which DO check.
close_reason: Added len<0 guards at neighbors_get fallback (:705-712) and routes_get fallback (:884-891) mirroring checked sites :727-730/:903-906 -> TOO_MANY_REQUESTS response instead of huge (size_t)len payload. Verified: clang -fsyntax-only of full TU via verbatim-subset Zephyr 4.1 shim (exit=0, canary-sensitive harness); cppcheck 2.21 clean.
